info.title: Magica Clone API
info.description: Send messages to the agent, read conversations, follow runs, answer approvals, and run Magica tools directly. Every response carries `x-api-version: 1` and `x-trace-id`; every error is `{ error, code, details?, traceId }`. Work that takes time starts at once and returns a run to poll.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: What we send to your webhook URL.

post.description: Sends a message to the agent, in a new chat or (with `chatId`) an existing one, and returns at once with the run to poll.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes the request safe to repeat: the same key with the same body (within 24 hours) returns the first answer without doing the work again (`idempotent-replayed: true`); a different body, or a repeat while the first is still running, is a 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. A request that failed can be repeated with the same key.

202.description: Accepted: the agent is working on it.

400.description: The request isn't valid (`VALIDATION_FAILED`): `error` says which field and why.

401.description: No valid API key or session token (`UNAUTHORIZED`).

409.description: A conflict: a run is already active in the chat (`RUN_ACTIVE`), or the Idempotency-Key was used differently (`IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`).

429.description: A limit was reached (`RATE_LIMITED`): see `Retry-After` and `details`.

503.description: A service the request needs is unavailable right now (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`): try again.

post.description: The chat-completions format, answered by the agent through the free model router (`model` must be `openrouter/free`). Not streamed. The conversation is kept as a chat. Waits about a minute for the answer; if it takes longer, answers 202 with the run to poll.

post.description: `agent.started`: The agent started working on the message. Verify the signature with the `svix` package and the `whsec_…` secret you were given; answer 2xx quickly (anything else is retried with backoff, about five times over half an hour), and treat a repeated `svix-id` as the same event.

parameters.name: svix-id
parameters.description: The event's id: the same on every retry of it.

parameters.name: svix-timestamp
parameters.description: When this attempt was sent (seconds since the epoch).

parameters.name: svix-signature
parameters.description: `v1,` and the base64 HMAC-SHA256 of `<svix-id>.<svix-timestamp>.<body>`.

post.description: `agent.completed`: The agent finished: `data` has the reply's id, the model and usage (tokens and credits). Verify the signature with the `svix` package and the `whsec_…` secret you were given; answer 2xx quickly (anything else is retried with backoff, about five times over half an hour), and treat a repeated `svix-id` as the same event.

ApiKey.name: x-api-key
ApiKey.description: An API key (`mgc_…`) from API / MCP in the app.

Bearer.description: An API key (`Bearer mgc_…`), or a signed-in session token.

mode.description: text: create a new image from the prompt. edit: change the image(s) in image_urls as the prompt says.

prompt.description: What to create, or how to change the image.

image_urls.description: Edit mode only: the image(s) to start from.

crop.description: The rectangle to keep: top-left corner (x, y) and size, in percent of the image (default) or pixels.

unit.description: percent (the default): every value is 0-100, a share of the image's size. pixel: whole pixels; set it whenever the values are pixels.

video_urls.description: The videos to join, in the order they should play.

model.description: The model: the free model router.
